## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and repository content is in English.
- [ ] Bug fixes include meaningful regression coverage.
- [ ] Test speedups do not alter production gameplay or reduce browser coverage.
- [ ] README, changelog and version metadata match the change.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, saved player data or test artifacts are committed.
- [ ] Local checks, remote CI and real-device verification are reported separately.
